description: The Peace Candidate Friends, I've been the peace candidate since 2014, when I was our party's nominee for the United States Senate, something that still gives me a great deal of pleasure to say. Anyway, one Sunday morning late in the campaign, about 4 am, I am up and hear my phone buzzing. I ignore it, but it won't stop, so we go check it, and we are being bombarded with texts [...]
title: Trail Mix 1 – Gaylon Kent For Congress
